findings.title: Replacing a long preview collapsed the scrollable document
findings.cause: Removing a long table/PDF preview for a short status or native-format message changed document height and allowed the browser to clamp the outer scroll. File lookup and preview also shared one invalidation counter.
findings.fix: Keep stable independent list and preview panes, a non-collapsing status line and persistent controls. Replace only preview content, preserve pane position where possible, and separate list/preview generations. Ignore stale PDF errors.

findings.title: Reviewed interactive plots were difficult to find among files
findings.cause: The file-kind filter had only tables, PDFs and images; reviewed regeneratable figures were hidden inside a report and not selectable as separate entries.
findings.fix: Add Plotted graphics with one entry per reviewed reproducible figure, keyed by exact source hash. Exclude original-only images and unreviewed spreadsheets. Reuse the loaded PDF when switching its reviewed figures.

findings.title: Graph reading lacked a direct series-specific hover tooltip
findings.cause: Pointer movement updated the equation table/readout, but the chart did not identify the nearest visible curve at the pointer with a local tooltip.
findings.fix: Evaluate the reviewed equation at pointer x, hit-test only visible in-window curves, and show series, x, y and calculation provenance. Keep original-only graphs nonnumerical; four decimals are calculation digits, not measurement accuracy.

limitations: No XLSX parser was added; workbook files retain the native-application explanation. CSV/TSV and supported source documents remain inline.
Only the two previously reviewed BASS equation figures are currently plotted entries; the original-only graph is excluded and no arbitrary plot is digitized.
Source curves use published rounded coefficients; hover decimals do not imply measurement precision or a fire-risk prediction.
Preview-internal scrolling can only be retained up to the new content extent. The outer document and file controls remain stable.
Browser uses the actual application/catalog and two TEST ONLY provider fixtures, not a live Gemini call. Clean second-machine and signing/SmartScreen verification remain open.

The independent Astra/High third-party collection has its own manifest and is not automatically used as validated production model evidence. NASA core is preserved; NPR Class C remains an incomplete engineering target.
